title: Finance needs a list of overdue invoices
prompt: Finance chases late payers by hand. Add `GET /invoices/overdue` (admin only) returning every invoice that is still `open` and whose due date has passed, the one that fell due longest ago first. Each entry is the invoice plus a `daysOverdue` field: the whole days since the due date, and at least 1 for anything that is overdue. Paid and void invoices never appear.
